item.title: Car Magnet
item.description: Turn your vehicle into a mobile billboard. No paint, no permanence, no problem. These custom car magnets are the easiest way to promote your business, support your favorite team or add a little personality to your ride. Made from durable, weather-resistant magnetic material, they stick securely to any metal surface and peel off cleanly whenever you're ready for a change. They are built to last, reusable and extremely versatile.

item.title: Union Envelope
item.description: Regular #10 Mailing Envelope ideal for political campaigns, labor organizations, endorsements, events, and hand distribution. These Envelopes feature an official union bug, indicating they came off the press at a union print shop. From the folks who set the ink to the ones who packed the box, these pieces were made by workers covered by a collective bargaining agreement.

item.title: Lawn Sign
item.description: Lightweight, durable, and weather-resistant corrugated plastic signs ideal for indoor and outdoor use. A cost-effective choice for real estate, political, yard, event, construction, and promotional signage. Available in 4mm thickness and with/out step stakes. Suitable for up to 12–18 months outdoors and 2+ years indoors.
